deviations: Complex invalid-argument messages are not compared; TypeError/code are checked.
The upstream probe replacing process.cwd with an empty provider is excluded: this profile intentionally has immutable virtual cwd.
Windows-host-only filesystem/process blocks are not selected in the POSIX virtual profile.

globReport.historicalOraclePolicy: Only nocase is fixed false to select the portable POSIX-host policy; all other options are exactly Node22 path.glob. Hostile patterns never reach the vulnerable historical oracle.
globReport.patchedMatcher: minimatch11.0.1 + nonrecursive-glob-match1.0.3 + strict profile budgets and Node22 UTF16/class shim

limitations: Virtual cwd and fixed POSIX-host glob case policy are explicit deviations; no host environment, filesystem or drive-state behavior is claimed.
Matcher resource budgets intentionally exclude unbounded inputs and replace upstream silent truncation with coded RangeError.
No broad DEBUG indirect Component Model ABI support is claimed. This uses the audited Release engine.
